title: JaxNaviSim: A GPU-Accelerated, Data-Driven Simulator and Learning Benchmark for Maritime Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30600v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coordinating vessels through the shared waterways of busy ports grows more challenging as vessel traffic increases. Port authorities need realistic simulations to assess how arrival schedules, anchorage assignments, and routes affect vessel throughput and navigation safety. Existing AIS-based trajectory models predict a vessel's track from its past trajectory in an open-loop fashion. They do not simulate step-by-step responses to other ships or test whether a vessel collides or reaches its goal. To address this problem, we introduce JaxNaviSim, a data-driven simulator and learning benchmark coupling Automatic Identification System (AIS) data with fast, controllable traffic simulation, in which learned models steer vessels through recorded traffic. translated_title: JaxNaviSim：一个GPU加速的、数据驱动的海上导航模拟器与学习基准
translated_abstract: 随着船舶交通量的增加，在繁忙港口的共享航道中协调船舶变得越来越具有挑战性。港务局需要逼真的模拟来评估到达计划、锚地分配和航线对船舶吞吐量与航行安全的影响。现有的基于AIS（船舶自动识别系统）的轨迹模型以开环方式仅根据船舶过去的轨迹预测其航行路线，无法模拟船舶对其他船只的逐步响应，也无法测试船舶是否会碰撞或到达目的地。为解决这一问题，我们推出了JaxNaviSim——一个数据驱动的模拟器与学习基准，它将AIS数据与快速、可控的交通模拟相结合，由学习到的模型引导船舶在真实记录的交通环境中航行。首先，我们发布了一个数据集，包含来自新加坡海峡（世界上最繁忙的水道之一）八个高密度区域超过3万艘船舶的约1.41亿条AIS记录，涵盖约670万个航次。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文推出了JaxNaviSim——一个GPU加速的数据驱动海上导航模拟器与学习基准，将AIS真实数据与快速可控的交通模拟相结合，并发布了新加坡海峡八个高密度区域超3万艘船舶约1.41亿条AIS记录的大规模数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces JaxNaviSim, a GPU-accelerated, data-driven maritime navigation simulator and learning benchmark that couples AIS data with fast, controllable traffic simulation, along with a dataset of ~141 million AIS records from over 30K vessels across eight high-density regions of the Singapore Strait.
